# ==========================================================
	# PARAMETER DATA POPULATION
	#
	# CASE 1:
	# Parent has direct AtomicTags
	#
	#   parameterData_0 -> Parent AtomicTags
	#   parameterData_1 -> First enabled UDT
	#   parameterData_2 -> Second enabled UDT
	#
	#
	# CASE 2:
	# Parent has NO direct AtomicTags
	#
	#   parameterData_0 -> First enabled UDT
	#   parameterData_1 -> Second enabled UDT
	#   parameterData_2 -> Third enabled UDT
	#
	# This MUST match the tab indexing.
	# ==========================================================
	
	
	# ----------------------------------------------------------
	# Get parent path
	# ----------------------------------------------------------
	
	parentPath = str(
	    self.view.params.Tag_Path_0
	)
	
	if not parentPath:
	    return
	
	
	# ==========================================================
	# STEP 1
	# CHECK DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS UNDER PARENT
	# ==========================================================
	
	parentChildren = system.tag.browse(
	    parentPath
	)
	
	parentAtomicPaths = []
	parentAtomicNames = []
	
	
	for child in parentChildren.getResults():
	
	    if str(child["tagType"]) == "AtomicTag":
	
	        parentAtomicNames.append(
	            str(child["name"])
	        )
	
	        parentAtomicPaths.append(
	            str(child["fullPath"])
	        )
	
	
	# ==========================================================
	# STEP 2
	# DETERMINE STARTING INDEX
	# ==========================================================
	
	dataIndex = 0
	
	
	# ==========================================================
	# CASE 1
	# PARENT HAS DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS
	# ==========================================================
	
	if len(parentAtomicPaths) > 0:
	
	    parameterData = []
	
	
	    # ------------------------------------------------------
	    # Read parent AtomicTags
	    # ------------------------------------------------------
	
	    values = system.tag.readBlocking(
	        parentAtomicPaths
	    )
	
	
	    for i in range(len(parentAtomicPaths)):
	
	        parameterData.append({
	
	            "Parameter": parentAtomicNames[i],
	
	            "Value": values[i].value
	        })
	
	
	    # ------------------------------------------------------
	    # Parent occupies index 0
	    # ------------------------------------------------------
	
	    self.view.custom[
	        "parameterData_0"
	    ] = parameterData
	
	
	    # First UDT starts at index 1
	    dataIndex = 1
	
	
	# ==========================================================
	# CASE 2
	# PARENT HAS NO DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS
	# ==========================================================
	
	else:
	
	    # First enabled UDT starts at index 0
	    dataIndex = 0
	
	
	# ==========================================================
	# STEP 3
	# GET UDT INSTANCES
	# ==========================================================
	
	results = system.tag.browse(
	    parentPath,
	    {
	        "tagType": "UdtInstance"
	    }
	)
	
	udtInstances = results.getResults()
	
	
	# ==========================================================
	# STEP 4
	# PROCESS ENABLED UDTs
	# ==========================================================
	
	for item in udtInstances:
	
	    udtPath = str(
	        item["fullPath"]
	    )
	
	
	    # ------------------------------------------------------
	    # Check Enabled
	    # ------------------------------------------------------
	
	    enabledPath = (
	        udtPath + ".enabled"
	    )
	
	    enabledResult = system.tag.readBlocking(
	        [enabledPath]
	    )[0]
	
	
	    if not enabledResult.value:
	        continue
	
	
	    # ======================================================
	    # GET DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS INSIDE UDT
	    # ======================================================
	
	    childResults = system.tag.browse(
	        udtPath
	    )
	
	    tagPaths = []
	    tagNames = []
	
	
	    for child in childResults.getResults():
	
	        if str(child["tagType"]) == "AtomicTag":
	
	            tagNames.append(
	                str(child["name"])
	            )
	
	            tagPaths.append(
	                str(child["fullPath"])
	            )
	
	
	    # ======================================================
	    # READ VALUES
	    # ======================================================
	
	    parameterData = []
	
	
	    if len(tagPaths) > 0:
	
	        values = system.tag.readBlocking(
	            tagPaths
	        )
	
	
	        for i in range(len(tagPaths)):
	
	            parameterData.append({
	
	                "Parameter": tagNames[i],
	
	                "Value": values[i].value
	            })
	
	
	    # ======================================================
	    # STORE USING CURRENT TAB INDEX
	    # ======================================================
	
	    propertyName = (
	        "parameterData_" +
	        str(dataIndex)
	    )
	
	    self.view.custom[
	        propertyName
	    ] = parameterData
	
	
	    # ======================================================
	    # NEXT ENABLED UDT
	    # ======================================================
	
	    dataIndex += 1

# ==================================================
    # GET VALUES
    # ==================================================

    if value is None:
        return []

    parentPath = str(value["tagPath"])

    currentIndex = value["currentIndex"]

    if currentIndex is None:
        currentIndex = 0

    currentIndex = int(currentIndex)

    if not parentPath:
        return []


    # ==================================================
    # TOOLTIP DATA
    # ==================================================

    manData = self.view.params.Man_Data

    tabs = []


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 1
    # CHECK FOR DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS
    # ==================================================

    childResults = system.tag.browse(parentPath)

    hasAtomicTags = False

    for child in childResults.getResults():

        if str(child["tagType"]) == "AtomicTag":

            hasAtomicTags = True
            break


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 2
    # CREATE COR001 TAB ONLY IF
    # DIRECT ATOMIC TAGS EXIST
    # ==================================================

    tabIndex = 0


    if hasAtomicTags:

        toolTipText = ""

        if manData is not None:

            if tabIndex < len(manData):

                dataItem = manData[tabIndex]

                if dataItem is not None:

                    toolTipText = str(
                        dataItem.get(
                            "tab_tooltip",
                            ""
                        )
                    )


        tabs.append({

            "viewPath": "widgets(templates)/TabButton",

            "viewParams": {

                # Parent UDT name
                "tabText": parentPath.split("/")[-1],

                # Tooltip
                "toolTipText": toolTipText,

                # Selected state
                "tabSelected": (
                    tabIndex == currentIndex
                )
            },

            "runWhileHidden": False
        })


        # COR001 occupied index 0
        tabIndex += 1


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 3
    # GET UDT INSTANCES
    # ==================================================

    results = system.tag.browse(
        parentPath,
        {
            "tagType": "UdtInstance"
        }
    )

    udtInstances = results.getResults()


    # ==================================================
    # STEP 4
    # CREATE TABS FOR ENABLED UDTs ONLY
    # ==================================================

    for item in udtInstances:

        udtPath = str(item["fullPath"])


        # --------------------------------------------------
        # CHECK ENABLED
        # --------------------------------------------------

        enabledPath = udtPath + ".enabled"

        enabledResult = system.tag.readBlocking(
            [enabledPath]
        )[0]


        if not enabledResult.value:
            continue


        # ==================================================
        # TOOLTIP
        # ==================================================

        toolTipText = ""

        if manData is not None:

            if tabIndex < len(manData):

                dataItem = manData[tabIndex]

                if dataItem is not None:

                    toolTipText = str(
                        dataItem.get(
                            "tab_tooltip",
                            ""
                        )
                    )


        # ==================================================
        # CREATE UDT TAB
        # ==================================================

        tabs.append({

            "viewPath": "widgets(templates)/TabButton",

            "viewParams": {

                # UDT name
                "tabText": str(item["name"]),

                # Tooltip
                "toolTipText": toolTipText,

                # Selected state
                "tabSelected": (
                    tabIndex == currentIndex
                )
            },

            "runWhileHidden": False
        })


        # Next visible tab
        tabIndex += 1


    # ==================================================
    # RETURN TABS
    # ==================================================

    return tabs
